output.summary: The decline is mostly a sustainer collapse that began at the February 2026 GiveLedger cutover, before the new executive director started. 702 of 1,140 profiles were imported without payment methods, and no donor outreach followed. The major-gift drop is explained by one non-recurring $75,000 Brandt gift, and repeat-giving rates are normal. Whether the $181,300 in CardVault deposits is sustainer money (a recording gap) or corporate and tenant payments is unresolved. Economic and appeal-tone effects on small gifts are plausible but unseparated. Firing the director is unsupported and harmful. Closing CardVault risks losing the records and live gifts. Mass re-solicitation risks double charging. Prefer reconciling CardVault now and agreeing who makes the stewardship calls.
